trust_decision.summary: Whether a client-supplied HTTP/2 header field is well-formed (no CR/LF/NUL) and so may be handed to the Plug application as req_headers/host/path/method; decided in Bandit.HTTPTransport.read_headers for HTTP/2 (stream.ex), mirroring the HTTP/1 per-header check in http1/socket.ex.

landing_point.why: The HTTP/2 read_headers validation chain (split_headers!, headers_all_lowercase!, no_connection_headers!, valid_te_header!) is where every other RFC9113 request-header check lives; the HTTP/1 equivalent at lib/bandit/http1/socket.ex:195 is the obvious model to copy.

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTP/2 HEADERS (+CONTINUATION) frame on a new stream -> Bandit.HTTP2.Connection.handle_frame (lib/bandit/http2/connection.ex:152-176) -> Stream.read_headers (lib/bandit/http2/stream.ex:125)
same as above; new valid_field_values!/2 applied to regular (non-pseudo) headers only
same HTTP/2 HEADERS route; new at_most_one_instance_of!(:authority)
same HTTP/2 HEADERS route; helper for duplicate :authority
shared helper Bandit.Headers.field_value_valid?/1 (internal, @moduledoc false), called from both transports

HTTP/1 request header lines -> Bandit.HTTP1.Socket.read_headers (lib/bandit/http1/socket.ex:63) -> do_read_headers! (lib/bandit/http1/socket.ex:164-165); refactor only, already protected at pinned commit

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The HTTP/1 change (fix.diff:122-143) and the Bandit.Headers helper (fix.diff:81-96) are refactors of an existing check (lib/bandit/http1/socket.ex:195-214); no new protection lands outside the HTTP/2 stream module.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The advisory and RFC9113 section talk about 'header field values', and pseudo-headers are split off before the regular-header checks (lib/bandit/http2/stream.ex:130) and have their own dedicated checks (:path must start with '/', :authority parsed as host:port), so a solver can argue pseudo-headers and header names are a separate, already-validated concern.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate values must keep working: HTAB and obs-text bytes in values, ':' inside :authority (host:port, IPv6 '[::1]:4000') and header values, split cookie crumbs joined with '; ', and 'te: trailers'. An over-broad fix (rejecting all control bytes incl. tab, rejecting ':' or non-ASCII, or validating after cookie joining with a stricter rule) breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: CR inside a regular header value (fix.diff:219-238)
bare LF inside a regular header value (fix.diff:241-260)
NUL inside a regular header value (fix.diff:263-283)
any of the above in any regular header of the list, including split cookie crumbs (checked before combine_cookie_crumbs, fix.diff:158-160)

O7_producer.where: Headers are produced by HPAX.decode in lib/bandit/http2/connection.ex:155 (external dependency) and consumed directly by the check; no schema/serializer/cache in between.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: HTTP/2 pseudo-header values (:authority -> conn.host, :method -> conn.method, :path -> request_path/query_string) are never CR/LF/NUL-checked because valid_field_values! runs only on the post-split regular list.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Pseudo-headers 'are not header fields' and already have their own checks (:path prefix at lib/bandit/http2/stream.ex:163-171, :authority parse at lib/bandit/headers.ex:98-111, which splits on ':' and does not reject CR/LF).
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as landing point; values flow into lib/bandit/pipeline.ex:78-81 and lib/bandit/headers.ex:98-111

O8_uncovered_routes.route: HTTP/2 header field names: no CR/LF/NUL (or other invalid name char) check; only A-Z is rejected, so a name with CR/LF reaches req_headers.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The advisory says 'field values'; HTTP/1 names come pre-tokenised from :erlang.decode_packet (lib/bandit/http1/socket.ex:158-167), so the mirrored HTTP/1 check covers only values.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: deliver HTTP/2 request trailers to the app (or log them raw) without running the field-value check
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Trailers are currently decoded and only pseudo-header-checked then dropped; a maintainer adding trailer support would naturally reuse no_pseudo_headers! only.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: HTTP/1 chunked trailers surfaced to the app via a separate parse path
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Trailers already go through do_read_headers! with a fake socket; a rewrite to a lighter trailer parser could drop validate_field_value!.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: WebSocket handshake reading Sec-WebSocket-* values from a separately parsed source
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Handshake code already handles header lists itself; a planted re-parse would be a plausible second implementation at distance.

O9_family: CWE-93 CRLF injection / HTTP header field-value validation (request side, HTTP/2)

O10_build.toolchain: Erlang/OTP + Elixir ~> 1.13 (mix.exs), mix deps.get from Hex (thousand_island, hpax, plug, etc.)
O10_build.project_tests: test/bandit/http2/protocol_test.exs (SimpleH2Client, stream-error assertions), test/bandit/http1/protocol_test.exs:453 (HTTP/1 CR/LF/NUL rejection)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add Enum.any?(headers, &invalid_value?/1) next to valid_te_header! on the post-split regular headers, leaving pseudo-header values and header names unchecked.

out_of_scope_notes: Response-side: lib/bandit/http1/socket.ex:549-553 writes response header k/v raw with CRLF; inform/3 headers (lib/bandit/adapter.ex:251-261) are not validated in Bandit (Plug's put_resp_header may validate) - different direction, not pursued.
The published fix also adds duplicate-:authority rejection (fix.diff:154), unrelated to CR/LF/NUL.
